description: This file defines a static class providing product version information fetched from GitVersion. It exposes version-related data such as major, minor, patch, pre-release label, semantic version, informational version, branch name, and commit date as static string properties.

classes.name: PdfSharpInternal.PdfSharpGitVersionInformation
classes.description: A static class encapsulating version information retrieved from the GitVersion tool, utilized for display or logging purposes within the application.
